title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: Facilitator AI notes for in-person meetings
summary: The briefing's rollout, licensing, default state and configuration instructions are supported by Microsoft's sources. Two minor corrections remain: cite the scheduled-meeting limitations source and remove the checklist instruction for a setting that has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: This roadmap item concerns AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows

claims.claim: Facilitator takes notes in scheduled Teams meetings.
claims.quote: Facilitator is an AI-powered agent in Teams that can automatically take notes of the conversations that happen during a meeting, provide key highlights, and answer prompts in the meeting chat.

claims.claim: Microsoft is extending Facilitator to physical-room discussions without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.
claims.quote: This enhancement allows teams meeting in a physical room to capture real-time notes, decisions, and action items—without requiring a scheduled or hybrid meeting.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes inviting Facilitator with one tap on the room console.
claims.quote: Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console.

claims.quote: Ensure Facilitator is enabled in your tenant.

claims.where: Scope; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: MC1307512 asks administrators to ensure transcription is enabled in Teams meeting policies.
claims.quote: Ensure meeting transcription is enabled in Teams meeting policies.

claims.claim: The room-console Take notes control is at Pro Management portal > Rooms > room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.
claims.quote: In Pro Management portal, select Rooms from the left navigation > select your desired room > Settings > Device > Show Take notes button on the home screen.

claims.claim: No API for the Pro Management portal Take notes setting is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management Take notes API PowerShell settings; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/teams Facilitator Take notes; Take notes XML Teams Rooms. Read Facilitator setup, Pro portal settings and the Windows feature troubleshooting excerpt; no setting API found.

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is configured at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in the named meeting policy.
claims.quote: To manage meeting transcription using PowerShell, use the -AllowTranscription parameter in Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy. ... Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.claim: Meeting transcription is a user-scoped policy control.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting.

claims.claim: The documentation does not identify a particular meeting policy used by room accounts for in-person Facilitator notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Facilitator in person transcription policy room resource account; Teams Rooms Facilitator policy in-person transcription. Read Facilitator setup, transcription and Rooms release-note excerpts: general meeting policies are named, not a particular in-person policy.

claims.claim: An admin-centre UI path for the Teams Loop SharePoint properties is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Loop IsLoopEnabled IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled admin center UI. Read Loop admin configuration, including its Admin Center, Cloud Policy and Teams sections; the UI controls workspaces, while these Teams properties use SharePoint PowerShell.

claims.claim: Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true enables Loop components in Teams through SharePoint PowerShell.
claims.quote: To enable Loop components in Teams, run Set-SPOTenant -IsLoopEnabled $true.

claims.claim: IsLoopEnabled applies tenant-wide.
claims.quote: IsLoopEnabled (boolean) ... This property controls Loop component creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled is a tenant-wide property for collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote: This property controls the collaborative meeting notes creation and integration in Microsoft Teams. It applies to the entire tenant and can't be configured at the user level.

claims.claim: The collaborative meeting notes SharePoint property does not apply to Teams New Calendar collaborative meeting notes.
claims.quote: The SharePoint organization property doesn't apply to collaborative meeting notes in Teams New Calendar, see Settings management in Cloud Policy.

claims.claim: Learn's in-person Facilitator transcription setup links to the general meeting transcription policy documentation.
claims.quote:
Step 2: Turn on transcription for meetings

For more information, see Manage transcription for meetings.

claims.claim: The Learn setup step for the portal Take notes setting does not name a platform.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Pro Management Take notes API PowerShell settings. Read the full Facilitator in Teams Rooms page: Step 4 gives the room-level portal path without a Windows or Android qualifier.

claims.claim: Facilitator in scheduled meetings has documented sensitivity-label limitations.
claims.quote: AI-generated notes for meetings don't inherit the meeting's sensitivity label; however, a sensitivity label can be applied to the notes' Loop component in the Loop app or OneDrive.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/facilitator-teams to sources for the sensitivity-label and eDiscovery limitations mentioned in Open questions.

claims.claim: Facilitator in scheduled meetings has documented eDiscovery limitations.
claims.quote: Facilitator's AI-generated notes for meetings aren't automatically collected as cloud attachments in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery because it isn't currently supported.

claims.claim: The Facilitator in Teams Rooms page does not state whether scheduled-meeting sensitivity-label and eDiscovery limitations apply to in-person notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Facilitator Teams Rooms in-person notes sensitivity labels eDiscovery. Read the complete Rooms Facilitator page, scheduled Facilitator limitations and Purview search excerpts; the Rooms page does not state the applicability of those scheduled-meeting limitations.

claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to confirm IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled, but the controls table has no row for that control.
claims.quote: confirm the IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled prerequisite that MC1307512 lists. ... Loop components in Teams (IsLoopEnabled)
claims.fix: Replace the Loop checklist bullet with 'Check IsLoopEnabled is on, using the Loop row below.' Keep the IsCollabMeetingNotesFluidEnabled prerequisite in Scope and the existing row note; do not add a control row.
